description: One row in the audit timeline.

actorUserId.description: Id of the user (or API-key owner) that triggered the event.

targetKind.description: Short discriminator of what the event refers to.

targetId.description: Id of the affected entity. Null when the event doesn't reference a single row.

payload.description: Action-specific context keys parsed from the row's payload_json column. A malformed payload falls back to a single `_raw` key.
